user.title: Smart Climate – Add room
user.description: Optional: select the HA area that corresponds to this room. This pre-fills the room name in the next step and restricts the sensor/device selection lists to the entities assigned to that area. Leave empty to choose from all entities as before.

room.title: Smart Climate – Add room
room.description: Set up monitoring for one room. If an HA area was selected in the previous step, the room name is already pre-filled from it and the sensor/device selection lists below are already restricted to the entities assigned to that area (domains without a matching entity in the area remain unrestricted). Repeat this flow for additional rooms (Settings → Devices & Services → Add integration). Cross-room defaults live under the automatically created "Smart Climate Options" entry (Configure).

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Which entities provide the indoor measurements for this room?

data_description.temperature_source_entity: A climate, sensor, number or input_number entity
data_description.temperature_attribute: Only relevant if a climate entity was selected as indoor temperature above
data_description.co2_entity: A sensor entity with a CO2 value in ppm. Unlike temperature/humidity, there is no outdoor comparison for this - ventilating always helps when CO2 is high

ventilation.name: Windows & Ventilation
ventilation.description: Window, shutter, normal-range limits and protection features. Optional fields override the global settings. Left empty, the global value applies (Settings → Devices & Services → Smart Climate Options → Configure).

data_description.no_window: On: open/close notifications are never generated - useful for windowless hallways/basement rooms where only the dehumidifier/air conditioner should be controlled based on sensor readings. Device control keeps working regardless of this setting.
data_description.shutter_entity: Only together with an air conditioner. Optional: a cover entity (open/close) or a switch entity (1 = lowered+locked, 0 = raised+unlocked). Activated when the air conditioner turns on, deactivated again when it turns off
data_description.disable_close_recommendation: No "please close" recommendation is ever made for this room (temperature/humidity/CO2/winter max duration/summer case have no effect) - useful when the window contact doesn't reliably reflect the actual state (e.g. a sliding door) or an air conditioner handles cooling independently of the window. Frost/heat protection are unaffected and still close immediately. Open recommendations are unaffected too.
data_description.temp_threshold_open: Upper limit of the normal range – recommends opening when exceeded. Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_temp_threshold_open}
data_description.temp_threshold_close: Lower limit of the normal range – recommends closing when undercut. Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_temp_threshold_close}
data_description.humidity_threshold_open: Upper limit of the normal range – recommends opening when exceeded. Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_humidity_threshold_open}
data_description.humidity_threshold_close: Lower limit of the normal range – recommends closing when undercut. Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_humidity_threshold_close}
data_description.co2_threshold_open: Upper limit of the normal range – recommends opening when exceeded. Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_co2_threshold_open}
data_description.co2_threshold_close: Lower limit of the normal range – recommends closing when undercut. Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_co2_threshold_close}
data_description.frost_protection_temp: Below this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately. Currently global: {global_frost_protection_temp}
data_description.heat_protection_temp: Above this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately - regardless of whether the room actually needs ventilating due to temperature, humidity or CO2. Currently global: {global_heat_protection_temp}
data_description.winter_outdoor_threshold: Below this outdoor temperature, conditions are considered "winter" (enables the max duration limit). Currently global: {global_winter_outdoor_threshold}
data_description.max_open_duration_winter_minutes: Under "winter" conditions, closing is recommended automatically after this duration. Currently global: {global_max_open_duration_winter_minutes}
data_description.temp_margin: Tolerance used for outdoor/indoor temperature comparisons, to avoid the recommendation flickering. Also acts as the hysteresis for the heating control and summer mode. Currently global: {global_temp_margin}
data_description.frost_debounce_minutes: Minimum duration the outdoor temperature must stay continuously at/below the frost protection limit, OR the outdoor sensor must stay continuously unavailable, before an open state is actually closed because of it - protects against a single outlier reading and against brief sensor unavailability at startup. 0 = close immediately without delay. Currently global: {global_frost_debounce_minutes}
data_description.humidity_priority_over_duration: Empty = use the global setting. Determines whether a still-active humidity or CO2 ventilation need takes priority when the winter max duration is reached (window stays open) or whether the max duration is enforced strictly (window closes anyway). Frost protection always takes priority regardless. Currently global: {global_humidity_priority_over_duration}

devices.name: Dehumidifier, AC & Shower
devices.description: Automatically controlled devices plus power, runtime and shower-detection settings. Optional fields override the global settings. Left empty, the global value applies (Settings → Devices & Services → Smart Climate Options → Configure).

data.device_max_runtime_minutes: Max. runtime at low surplus power
data.device_max_runtime_high_surplus_minutes: Max. runtime at high surplus power

data_description.dehumidifier_entity: A switch or humidifier entity. Turns on at high, off at low humidity
data_description.dehumidifier_tank_full_entity: Optional: a binary_sensor that reports "on" when the tank is full or there is a fault - shown on the dashboard card as an addition to the dehumidifier status (e.g. "error")
data_description.dehumidifier_tank_notification_enabled: Enables a real notification (voice announcement/app push/persistent notification, whichever is active for this room) as soon as the tank status sensor selected above reports "full" - only effective if a sensor is actually selected there.
data_description.ac_entity: A climate or switch entity. Turns on when it's too warm indoors and ventilating wouldn't help
data_description.device_window_conflict_notification_enab: Enables a real notification (voice announcement/app push/persistent notification, whichever is active for this room), while a dehumidifier and/or air conditioner configured here is fighting unfavourable outdoor air through an open window - regardless of any surplus feed-in power. Automatically resolves once the window is closed or the outdoor air becomes favourable again.
data_description.min_surplus_power_watts: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Only applies to turning on, never to turning off. Currently global: {global_min_surplus_power_watts}
data_description.dehumidifier_extreme_humidity: Empty = use the value from the global settings. 0 = off. From this humidity upwards the dehumidifier runs even when the surplus power is too low (minimum surplus power and shut-off delay do not apply then). Pause with open window, tank status and maximum runtime stay in effect. Currently global: {global_dehumidifier_extreme_humidity}
data_description.power_grace_period_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. A running device is only turned off for insufficient power once it has stayed low for this long. Currently global: {global_power_grace_period_minutes}
data_description.device_max_runtime_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Applies to dehumidifier and air conditioner. 0 = disabled. Applies at low surplus power (below the minimum surplus power) or without a power sensor: forces the device off once it has run this long uninterrupted. Currently global: {global_device_max_runtime_minutes}
data_description.device_max_runtime_high_surplus_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Applies to dehumidifier and air conditioner. 0 = unlimited. Applies at high surplus power (at least the minimum surplus power, only with a power sensor): forces the device off once it has run this long uninterrupted. Currently global: {global_device_max_runtime_high_surplus_minutes}
data_description.device_max_runtime_cooldown_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Minimum rest period after a forced shutoff due to max. runtime before the device may turn on again. Currently global: {global_device_max_runtime_cooldown_minutes}
data_description.shower_detection_enabled: Delays the open-window recommendation due to humidity while it is currently rising quickly (typical while showering) - venting during the shower itself doesn't help, since steam keeps being produced. Only relevant for rooms with a shower/bath, no extra sensor needed (uses the humidity sensor selected in the "Sensors" section). The rise threshold for this is directly below
data_description.shower_rise_threshold: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Only relevant if shower detection is enabled above. Currently global: {global_shower_rise_threshold}
data_description.shower_max_duration_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. 0 = off. Voice announcement on the room's speakers once the detected shower has run this long uninterrupted (once per shower, only with shower detection enabled). Currently global: {global_shower_max_duration_minutes}

heating.name: Heating
heating.description: Heating device, presets, presence check and setpoints for this room. Optional fields override the global settings. Left empty, the global value applies (Settings → Devices & Services → Smart Climate Options → Configure).

data.heating_use_temp_source: Also use temperature source for heating

data_description.heating_use_temp_source: Automatically uses the indoor temperature source selected above as the heating device, instead of selecting a second, separate entity in the "Heating" field - only effective if the temperature source is actually a climate entity (otherwise treated as "no heating configured"). When enabled, the "Heating" field directly below is ignored.
data_description.heating_entity: A climate entity. Switches between a comfort and a standby setpoint (further down in this section) instead of simply turning on/off - the usual way heating is operated. Also falls back to standby while the window is confirmed open. Ignored if "Also use temperature source for heating" above is enabled.
data_description.heating_use_preset_mode: Empty = use the global setting. Enabled (default, also globally), heating is controlled/shown via preset_mode instead of a numeric setpoint - but only if the entity actually supports preset_mode; otherwise it automatically falls back to setpoint control. Currently global: {global_heating_use_preset_mode}
data_description.heating_preset_comfort: The preset_mode name of the heating entity for the comfort state (e.g. "Comfort") - dropdown shows the presets actually reported by the entity, freely editable. Empty = this state keeps being set via the comfort setpoint instead of a preset. Currently global: {global_heating_preset_comfort}
data_description.heating_preset_standby: Like "Preset name Comfort", for the standby state. Currently global: {global_heating_preset_standby}
data_description.heating_preset_night: Like "Preset name Comfort", for the night state (called "Eco" on many devices, activated overnight) - only relevant with the heating schedule enabled. Currently global: {global_heating_preset_night}
data_description.heating_preset_building_protection: Like "Preset name Comfort", for the building-protection state - set exclusively while the window is confirmed open (replaces standby for that case). Without an entered name, the standby setpoint is used instead. Currently global: {global_heating_preset_building_protection}
data_description.heating_presence_entities: Optional: one or more person or device_tracker entities. If at least one is set, heating pauses (standby) as long as ALL of them confirm "away" - if at least one reports "home", or if any of their states is unknown/unavailable, heating continues normally. No effect without an entity set.
data_description.heating_threshold_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Below this indoor temperature, heating switches to the comfort setpoint; once threshold + tolerance margin is reached again, it switches back to standby. Only effective while "Enable heating schedule" below is OFF. Currently global: {global_heating_threshold_temp}
data_description.heating_comfort_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Setpoint applied once the indoor temperature drops below the heating threshold, or during the comfort time window. Currently global: {global_heating_comfort_temp}
data_description.heating_standby_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Setpoint outside comfort/night, e.g. while the window is open or nobody is home. Currently global: {global_heating_standby_temp}
data_description.heating_night_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Setpoint applied during the night time window (only if the heating schedule is enabled). Currently global: {global_heating_night_temp}

heating_schedule.name: Heating schedule
heating_schedule.description: Time windows in which comfort or night is enforced (separate for weekdays and weekends). Left empty, the global value applies (Settings → Devices & Services → Smart Climate Options → Configure).

data_description.heating_schedule_enabled: Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Climate Options". Enabled: the matching time window below forces the setpoint regardless of the indoor temperature; standby applies outside all windows. Disabled: the plain threshold logic above still applies. Currently global: {global_heating_schedule_enabled}
data_description.heating_comfort_start_weekday: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Only effective while the heating schedule is enabled. Currently global: {global_heating_comfort_start_weekday}
data_description.heating_comfort_end_weekday: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_heating_comfort_end_weekday}
data_description.heating_comfort_start_weekend: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_heating_comfort_start_weekend}
data_description.heating_comfort_end_weekend: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_heating_comfort_end_weekend}
data_description.heating_night_start_weekday: Empty = use the value from the global settings. If the comfort/night windows overlap, the night window takes priority. Currently global: {global_heating_night_start_weekday}
data_description.heating_night_end_weekday: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_heating_night_end_weekday}
data_description.heating_night_start_weekend: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_heating_night_start_weekend}
data_description.heating_night_end_weekend: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_heating_night_end_weekend}

notify.name: Notifications
notify.description: Voice announcement, app push, persistent notification and reminder. Enable the Home Assistant Companion App via the checkbox; the field directly below is only relevant if the checkbox is enabled. Voice announcement is active as soon as at least one speaker is selected.

data_description.sonos_entity: Multiple selection possible. Empty = no voice announcement for this room
data_description.tts_light_entity: Empty = voice announcements work regardless of the light (as before). If a light entity is set, announcements are only suppressed when this light is confirmed off - an unknown/unavailable state does NOT suppress the announcement.
data_description.tts_volume: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_tts_volume}
data_description.tts_quiet_hours_enabled: Empty = use the global setting. When enabled, suppresses only the voice announcement during the time window below - app push and persistent notification are not affected. Currently global: {global_tts_quiet_hours_enabled}
data_description.tts_quiet_start: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Only relevant if quiet hours above are enabled. Currently global: {global_tts_quiet_start}
data_description.tts_quiet_end: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_tts_quiet_end}
data_description.mobile_enabled: Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Climate Options". Currently global: {global_mobile_enabled}
data_description.mobile_targets: Empty = use the global targets from "Smart Climate Options". One or more notify entities. Each entry can optionally have a person or device_tracker entity - that target then only receives the push notification if the person/device is home. Without a presence entity, it is always sent. Currently global: {global_mobile_targets}
data_description.persistent_enabled: Notice in the Home Assistant web interface. Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Climate Options". Currently global: {global_persistent_enabled}
data_description.reminder_interval_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Recurring reminder if the recommendation is ignored. 0 = disabled. Currently global: {global_reminder_interval_minutes}

abort.already_configured: This room is already configured with this temperature source.

data_description.tts_quiet_end: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_tts_quiet_end}
data_description.mobile_enabled: Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Climate Options". Currently global: {global_mobile_enabled}
data_description.mobile_targets: Empty = use the global targets from "Smart Climate Options". One or more notify entities. Each entry can optionally have a person or device_tracker entity - that target then only receives the push notification if the person/device is home. Without a presence entity, it is always sent. Currently global: {global_mobile_targets}
data_description.persistent_enabled: Notice in the Home Assistant web interface. Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Climate Options". Currently global: {global_persistent_enabled}
data_description.reminder_interval_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Recurring reminder if the recommendation is ignored. 0 = disabled. Currently global: {global_reminder_interval_minutes}

data_description.area_id: HA area for this room - restricts the sensor/device selection lists below to the entities assigned to this area (domains without a matching entity in the area remain unrestricted). After changing this, save once - the selection lists are then shown updated for the new area, and anything else you already entered is kept; a second save applies the changes for good. Leave empty to choose from all entities as before.

global.title: Edit Smart Climate Options
global.description: These values act as the default for every room that doesn't override the respective field itself.

data_description.reset_to_defaults: When saved, resets all thresholds, setpoints, time windows and runtimes, the reminder interval and all notification message texts to their built-in defaults - regardless of what is currently entered in those fields. Selected entities (sensors, TTS, power sensor, notification targets) as well as the voice playback mode and notification methods are unaffected.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Outdoor sensors as the room-wide default.

data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Used for all rooms - can no longer be overridden per room
data_description.outdoor_humidity_entity: Used for all rooms, cannot be overridden per room. Without this sensor, ventilating on high indoor humidity is still recommended regardless of outdoor conditions. With it set, humidity-based ventilation is only recommended if it's actually drier outside than inside

ventilation.name: Windows & Ventilation
ventilation.description: Normal-range limits, frost/heat protection and fine-tuning as the room-wide default.

data_description.temp_threshold_open: Upper limit of the normal range – recommends opening when exceeded.
data_description.temp_threshold_close: Lower limit of the normal range – recommends closing when undercut.
data_description.humidity_threshold_open: Upper limit of the normal range – recommends opening when exceeded.
data_description.humidity_threshold_close: Lower limit of the normal range – recommends closing when undercut.
data_description.co2_threshold_open: Upper limit of the normal range – recommends opening when exceeded. Common recommendation: ventilate at 1000 ppm at the latest
data_description.co2_threshold_close: Lower limit of the normal range – recommends closing when undercut.
data_description.frost_protection_temp: Below this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately
data_description.heat_protection_temp: Above this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately - regardless of whether the room actually needs ventilating due to temperature, humidity or CO2
data_description.winter_outdoor_threshold: Below this outdoor temperature, conditions are considered "winter" (enables the max duration limit)
data_description.max_open_duration_winter_minutes: Under "winter" conditions, closing is recommended automatically after this duration
data_description.temp_margin: Tolerance used for outdoor/indoor temperature comparisons, to avoid the recommendation flickering. Also acts as the hysteresis for the heating control and summer mode
data_description.frost_debounce_minutes: Minimum duration the outdoor temperature must stay continuously at/below the frost protection limit, OR the outdoor sensor must stay continuously unavailable, before an open state is actually closed because of it - protects against a single outlier reading and against brief sensor unavailability at startup. 0 = close immediately without delay
data_description.humidity_priority_over_duration: On (default): if humidity or CO2 still needs ventilating, the winter max duration is ignored and the window stays open. Off: the max duration is enforced strictly, even at high humidity/CO2. Frost protection always takes priority regardless.

devices.name: Dehumidifier, AC & Shower
devices.description: Feed-in power sensor, runtimes and shower detection as the room-wide default.

data.device_max_runtime_minutes: Max. runtime at low surplus power
data.device_max_runtime_high_surplus_minutes: Max. runtime at high surplus power

data_description.power_entity: Used when a room doesn't set its own power sensor
data_description.min_surplus_power_watts: Default minimum threshold for all rooms without their own setting
data_description.dehumidifier_extreme_humidity: From this humidity upwards the dehumidifier runs even when the surplus power is too low (minimum surplus power and shut-off delay do not apply then) - 0 = off. Pause with open window, tank status and maximum runtime stay in effect. Default for all rooms without their own setting.
data_description.power_grace_period_minutes: Default delay for all rooms without their own setting
data_description.device_max_runtime_minutes: Maximum uninterrupted runtime at low surplus power (below the minimum surplus power or without a power sensor) before the dehumidifier/AC is forced off - 0 = disabled. Default for all rooms without their own value.
data_description.device_max_runtime_high_surplus_minutes: Maximum uninterrupted runtime at high surplus power (at least the minimum surplus power, only with a power sensor) before the dehumidifier/AC is forced off - 0 = unlimited. Default for all rooms without their own value.
data_description.device_max_runtime_cooldown_minutes: Minimum rest period after such a forced shutoff before the device may turn on again. Default for all rooms without their own value.
data_description.shower_rise_threshold: Humidity rise (percentage points per minute, measured over the last 10 minutes) above which an ongoing shower is assumed - only relevant for rooms that enabled shower detection
data_description.shower_max_duration_minutes: Voice announcement on the room's speakers once the detected shower has run this long uninterrupted (once per shower, only for rooms with shower detection and speakers) - 0 = off. Default for all rooms without their own value.

heating.name: Heating
heating.description: Presets, setpoints and summer mode as the room-wide default.

data_description.heating_use_preset_mode: Default Yes (opt-out): heating entities that support preset_mode (e.g. KNX) are controlled/shown via presets automatically instead of a numeric setpoint. Without support, it automatically stays on setpoint control - overridable per room to "No" to avoid using presets despite support.
data_description.heating_preset_comfort: Preset name for the comfort state (e.g. "Comfort") - dropdown only suggests the eight official Home Assistant standard values (no single device to read the actual presets from), freely editable. Empty = this state keeps being set via the comfort setpoint.
data_description.heating_preset_standby: Like "Preset name Comfort", for the standby state.
data_description.heating_preset_night: Like "Preset name Comfort", for the night state (called "Eco" on many devices).
data_description.heating_preset_building_protection: Like "Preset name Comfort", for the building-protection state (set while a window is confirmed open). Without an entered name, the standby setpoint is used instead.
data_description.heating_threshold_temp: Below this indoor temperature, heating switches to the comfort setpoint; once threshold + tolerance margin is reached again, it switches back to standby. Only effective while "Enable heating schedule" below is OFF.
data_description.heating_comfort_temp: Setpoint applied once the indoor temperature drops below the heating threshold, or during the comfort time window
data_description.heating_standby_temp: Setpoint outside comfort/night, e.g. while the window is open or nobody is home
data_description.heating_night_temp: Setpoint applied during the night time window (only if the heating schedule is enabled)
data_description.summer_mode_forecast_entity: A sensor or weather entity with a temperature forecast (e.g. your own template sensor with the daily forecast) - automatically controls the summer/winter mode switch selected below. Without this entity, the switch remains purely manual.
data_description.summer_mode_forecast_attribute: Name of an attribute on the forecast entity (above) to read the forecast value from (e.g. "temperature"). Empty = read the entity's state directly as a number.
data_description.summer_mode_switch_entity: Optional. An already existing switch entity (NOT created by this integration) - on = summer mode (heating paused in all rooms), off = winter mode (heating runs normally). Switched automatically based on the forecast source above, but remains manually operable at any time - a manual toggle is kept until the forecast clearly crosses the threshold (summer mode threshold further down) again. Without a configured entity, summer/winter mode has no effect.
data_description.summer_mode_threshold_temp: Once the forecast temperature reaches this value (+/- tolerance margin), the summer/winter mode switch is turned on automatically (summer mode), and off again below it (winter mode) - only effective if both a forecast source and the switch to control are configured above

heating_schedule.name: Heating schedule
heating_schedule.description: Time windows in which comfort or night is enforced (separate for weekdays and weekends), as the room-wide default.

data_description.heating_schedule_enabled: Enabled: the matching time window below forces the setpoint regardless of the indoor temperature; standby applies outside all windows. Disabled (default): the plain threshold logic above still applies
data_description.heating_comfort_start_weekday: Only effective while the heating schedule is enabled
data_description.heating_night_start_weekday: If the comfort/night windows overlap, the night window takes priority

notify.name: Notifications
notify.description: Voice announcement, app push, persistent notification and reminder interval as the room-wide default.

data_description.tts_entity: Used when a room doesn't set its own TTS entity
data_description.tts_volume: Volume the speakers are set to before the announcement - automatically restored to the previous value afterwards (see README)
data_description.tts_playback_mode: "Overlay" plays the announcement directly over any running playback. "Pause" pauses it first (not automatically resumed afterwards)
data_description.tts_quiet_hours_enabled: When enabled, suppresses only the voice announcement during the time window below - app push and persistent notification are not affected.
data_description.tts_quiet_start: Only effective if quiet hours above are enabled.
data_description.mobile_targets: One or more notify entities. Each entry can optionally have a person or device_tracker entity - that target then only receives the push notification if the person/device is home. Without a presence entity, it is always sent.
data_description.persistent_enabled: Creates a persistent notification in the Home Assistant notification panel while the recommendation is active - automatically dismissed once it's resolved
data_description.reminder_interval_minutes: Recurring reminder if the recommendation is ignored. 0 = disabled. Leaving it empty also becomes 0 when saved.

messages.name: Notification texts
messages.description: The texts sent for the respective recommendations. For the texts, three placeholders are available: ｛raum｝ (room name), ｛wert｝ (current measured value, including unit) and ｛schwelle｝ (the matching threshold, including unit).

data.msg_close_duration: Close due to winter max duration
data.msg_close_outdoor_wetter: Close because it's more humid outside

data_description.msg_open_humidity: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current humidity, ｛schwelle｝ = humidity threshold to open (each incl. %).
data_description.msg_open_co2: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current CO2 value, ｛schwelle｝ = CO2 threshold to open (each incl. ppm).
data_description.msg_open_temp: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current indoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = temperature threshold to open (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_default: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current indoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = temperature threshold to close (each incl. °C) - used e.g. when temperature alone triggers closing.
data_description.msg_close_humidity: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current humidity, ｛schwelle｝ = humidity threshold to close (each incl. %).
data_description.msg_close_co2: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current CO2 value, ｛schwelle｝ = CO2 threshold to close (each incl. ppm).
data_description.msg_close_frost: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current outdoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = frost protection limit (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_heat: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current outdoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = heat protection limit (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_duration: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = time open so far, ｛schwelle｝ = winter max duration (each incl. minutes).
data_description.msg_close_outdoor_warmer: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current outdoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = current indoor temperature (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_outdoor_wetter: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current absolute outdoor humidity, ｛schwelle｝ = current absolute indoor humidity (each incl. g/m³).
data_description.msg_reminder: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝/｛schwelle｝ = current value and open threshold of the original ventilation reason (temperature/humidity/CO2), each incl. its unit.
data_description.msg_tank_full: ｛raum｝ = room name. No ｛wert｝/｛schwelle｝, since the tank status is purely binary (full/not full).
data_description.msg_shower_long: ｛raum｝ = room name, ｛wert｝ = shower duration so far in minutes. Voice output only.
data_description.msg_device_window_conflict: Sent once a dehumidifier or air conditioner is fighting unfavourable outdoor air through an open window (see the room option "Notify on window/device conflict"). Placeholders: ｛raum｝, ｛geraet｝ ("Luftentfeuchter"/"Klimaanlage").

send_test_push.name: Send test push
send_test_push.description: Sends a test push message through the same path as the real notifications to all app push targets of the selected room - even if push is disabled for the room or the person is currently not home. The result (including whether a real notification would be sent right now) is listed in the push_verlauf attribute of the ventilation recommendation; a send error is returned as an error message.
